steps.template_en: Given i.i.d. data x₁,...,xₙ from distribution with θ, likelihood L(θ)=∏f(xᵢ|θ). MLE θ̂=argmax L(θ). Maximize log ℓ=Σlog f(xᵢ|θ). MLE = parameter making observed data MOST PROBABLE.
steps.template_zh: MLE θ̂=argmax L(θ)。最大化对数似然ℓ=Σlog f(xᵢ|θ)。MLE=使观测数据最可能的参数。

steps.template_en: X₁,...,Xₙ~Bernoulli(p): L(p)=p^{Σxᵢ}(1-p)^{n-Σxᵢ}. ℓ=(Σxᵢ)log p+(n-Σxᵢ)log(1-p). dℓ/dp=0 → p̂=Σxᵢ/n=x̄. MLE is the SAMPLE PROPORTION.
For N(μ,σ²): ∂ℓ/∂μ=0→μ̂=x̄. ∂ℓ/∂σ=0→σ̂²=(1/n)Σ(xᵢ-x̄)². Note: σ̂² is BIASED (divides by n, not n-1).
MLE properties (regular): (1) CONSISTENCY: θ̂ₙ→pθ. (2) ASYMPTOTIC NORMALITY: √n(θ̂ₙ-θ)→N(0,I(θ)⁻¹). I(θ)=Fisher info. (3) EFFICIENCY: achieves Cramér-Rao bound. (4) INVARIANCE: if τ=g(θ), τ̂=g(θ̂).
steps.template_zh: MLE性质：(1)相合。(2)渐近正态：I(θ)=Fisher信息量。(3)有效：达到Cramér-Rao下界。(4)不变性：τ=g(θ)则τ̂=g(θ̂)。

steps.template_en: Poisson(λ): (1) Derive MLE for λ. (2) Fisher information. (3) Asymptotic variance of λ̂? (4) MLE for √λ? (5) In R: compare MLE vs method of moments for n=10 and n=1000.
steps.template_zh: Poisson(λ): (1)推导λ的MLE。(2)Fisher信息量。(3)λ̂渐近方差？(4)√λ的MLE？(5)在R中比较n=10和n=1000。

steps.template_en: MLE is 'default' because ASYMPTOTICALLY OPTIMAL. Likelihood captures ALL info about θ. Maximizing it extracts maximum info. Fisher Info measures HOW MUCH info data provides about θ.
steps.template_zh: MLE是'默认'因渐近最优。似然捕获所有θ信息。最大化它提取最多信息。Fisher信息量衡量数据提供多少θ信息。
